title: ARM: Attention with Routed-Memory for Learnable Sparse Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.24417v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite advances in long-context inference, large language models (LLMs) remain fundamentally limited by the key-value (KV) caching mechanisms that are necessary for stable computation. Techniques such as selective token eviction and pruning have vastly mitigated these issues, but often discard core information to manage the growing cache. In this paper, we propose Attention with Routed Memory (ARM) a novel KV caching structure that introduces a fully differentiable, fixed-size memory system organized as a hierarchical router. Via a Gumbel-Softmax, ARM learns to select memory slots and perform sigmoid-gated updates that softly combine new and stored information, avoiding hard eviction and reducing information loss. By further training a policy to dynamically select varying amounts of memory at inference, ARM adapts its accesses for both simple contexts and inputs that require deeper reasoning, enabling more scalable and effective retriev

translated_title: ARM：具有路由记忆的可学习稀疏控制注意力机制
translated_abstract: 尽管长上下文推理已取得进展，大型语言模型（LLM）仍然从根本上受到稳定计算所必需的键值（KV）缓存机制的限制。诸如选择性 token 逐出和剪枝等技术极大地缓解了这些问题，但为了管理不断增长的缓存，往往会丢弃核心信息。在本文中，我们提出了带路由记忆的注意力机制（ARM），这是一种新颖的 KV 缓存结构，引入了一个完全可微分的、固定大小的记忆系统，该系统以分层路由器的形式组织。通过 Gumbel-Softmax，ARM 学会选择记忆槽位并执行 sigmoid 门控更新，从而将新信息与已存储的信息进行软性结合，避免了硬性逐出并减少了信息丢失。通过进一步训练一个策略以在推理时动态选择不同数量的记忆，ARM 能够同时适应简单上下文和需要更深层推理的输入，实现更具可扩展性和更有效的检索。
tldr: 提出ARM——一种基于分层路由器与Gumbel-Softmax的全可微固定大小KV缓存结构，通过sigmoid门控软性融合新旧信息避免硬性逐出，并能动态调整记忆访问量以适应不同复杂度的推理需求。
en_tdlr: ARM introduces a fully differentiable, fixed-size hierarchical-router KV cache that uses Gumbel-Softmax slot selection and sigmoid-gated soft updates to avoid hard eviction of information, while dynamically adapting memory access at inference for scalable long-context reasoning.
